rows.role_title: Председатель Правительства — Chairman of the Government
rows.text: Statement dated 24 February 2004, 17:32, Moscow, Kremlin: the President says that under Article 117 of the Constitution he has taken the decision on the resignation of the Government ('мною принято решение об отставке Правительства'); the decision is not a verdict on the outgoing Government's work, which he considers satisfactory overall, and is motivated by the wish to state his position on the country's course after 14 March 2004, since citizens should know the proposed composition of the highest executive body in the event of his election as President.
rows.locator: Paragraphs after the salutation: the decision under Article 117, its reasons, and the reference to 14 March 2004

rows.role_title: Председатель Правительства — Chairman of the Government
rows.text: He states that under Article 111 he intends to submit a candidate for Chairman of the Government to the State Duma within the established period, and that the Chairman will have a week after appointment to propose the structure of federal executive bodies.

rows.role_title: Председатель Правительства — Chairman of the Government
rows.text: He instructs the current Government to continue performing its duties until a new Government of the Russian Federation is formed.
